version_note: Lowest-assurance path. Plain text or structured data with no cryptographic binding. Grade caps at E1/E2. Per the grade gate, this path can essentially NEVER auto-pass — it routes to needs_review. The judgment here informs the human reviewer; it does not release funds. Keep this pack honest about that.
grade_note: Without identity binding or a nonce, effective grade stays E1. With a matched nonce but no identity, E2 at best. Either way < E3 -> grade gate -> needs_review. Do not let a high posterior override this.

internally_consistent.instructions: Is the text/data internally consistent and free of contradictions, rather than self-contradictory or implausible on its face?

criteria_met.instructions: Taking the content at face value, does it describe work that would satisfy the acceptance criteria? (This does NOT establish that the work happened — only that the description matches the requirement.)

review_priority.instructions: How much human scrutiny does this need before it could ever be trusted?
criteria: clearly insufficient as evidence; likely reject
strong for text-only, but still needs binding to trust

posterior_rule.note: Informational only. Verdict is needs_review by grade gate regardless of this value, unless L1 hard-rejects. The posterior is attached to the reviewer's view as decision support.
